Name: RUNTIME_SOUND_EXPRESSION_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines runtime sound expressions: conditions evaluated during play, combined with brackets or logical operators, that can drive a sound RTPC value.

Fields.Name: Expression Operator
Fields.Description: Bracket or logical operator (OR, AND) used to combine this row with the other expression rows.

Fields.Name: RTPC Calculation
Fields.Description: Enables RTPC calculation for this expression.

Fields.Name: Evaluation 1: Dummy Poly A
Fields.Description: Dummy poly ID A used by evaluation 1.

Fields.Name: Evaluation 1: Dummy Poly B
Fields.Description: Dummy poly ID B used by evaluation 1.

Fields.Name: RTPC Minimum Value
Fields.Description: Minimum RTPC value. Values from the RTPC minimum to the RTPC maximum are mapped to 0-100.

Fields.Name: RTPC Maximum Value
Fields.Description: Maximum RTPC value. Values from the RTPC minimum to the RTPC maximum are mapped to 0-100.

Fields.Name: Condition ID
Fields.Description: ID of the condition whose fulfilment state is checked.
